parameters.name: deploymentName
parameters.description: The name of the deployed job.

parameters.name: ignoreJobSummary
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude job summary information, such as jobName and status, from the response. Set this to true to return only the JobId and improve performance.

parameters.name: ignoreResourceSetting
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude resource configuration information, such as parallelism and the number of CUs, to reduce the response size.
